title: Apple Pie
hookLine: Global-inspired apple pie with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Peel and clean apples/rhubarb, cut in to a slices. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m53575_1}, {m53575_2}, {m53575_3}, and {m53575_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure apples first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: beat eggs and sugar together into a light foam. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs. Incorporate {m53575_5}, {m53575_6}, and {m53575_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix together flour, salt and baking powder. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Add  the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and add sour milk gradually while stirring,  Add berries. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Apple Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour dough in to a butter greased pan. Sprinkle over sugar (and cinnamon). Bake at 180 C for 30 minute. Let Apple Pie cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.
